card.name: The 2 in every 12 hours
card.fires_on: The digit 2 completing the number 12 right after 'every 1' or 'q1' in dosing intervals, just before 'hours' or 'h'. Also weakly on 'hours' after 'every 2'.

modes.label: 12 in dosing interval
modes.description: The final digit of 12 in 'every 12 hours' or 'q12h' schedules.
modes.example: aged 3 months to 12 years weighing less than or equal to 40 kg: 90 mg/kg/day divided every 1<<2>> hours, administered for 10 days

modes.label: Hours after every 2
modes.description: The word hours after a short interval in dosing instructions.
modes.example: To make sure accurate dosing every 2<< hours>>, you may want to set an alarm

card.writes: It promotes hour and hours words, suggesting a time unit comes next, and suppresses date and day words.
card.plain: It fires on the 2 in 'every 12 hours', where the next word is expected to be hours.
